model_output.verdict: A product designer with a current cafe role and design work that needs more context.
write_up: You have a product design background at Loop Fitness and Brightpath Studio, followed by your current barista role. It’s common for design resumes to name the work without saying what happened after it. Here, that makes it harder to stand out for Product Designer roles: a recruiter can see the projects, but not yet what your design decisions changed.

The line about creating Loop Fitness’s first design system is a strong model because it names a concrete deliverable and the tool you used. Your current job also makes the timeline easy to follow, while the portfolio link gives a recruiter somewhere to see more of your design work.

Let’s start with the Loop Fitness booking flow. Add a decision you made and the user need behind it, then show what you learned from testing. For Brightpath, name a client project you can discuss. You don’t need to explain away the cafe job.
